apps.name: Swipt
apps.subtitle: The universal iOS automation platform
apps.localizedDescription: Swipt automates this iPhone or iPad with JavaScript swiplets. It bundles a TypeScript SDK built on CoreDevice and the accessibility services, plus an MCP-compatible API for driving and debugging swiplets from your computer.
